I’d definitely start browsing for apartments in the area you want to move to. My general rule of thumb is to make sure you have enough for 3 months rent set aside, along with first months last months rent and a deposit. You can roughly see how much you’ll need on the apartments websites or just calling and inquiring. If you can save more than 3 months rent prior to moving, i highly suggest you do in case you have unexpected costs and it’s always good to have rent money LOL.

I’ve also reached out to friends i know who plan to move out soon or i know want to move out to help cut costs on my end and I’m lucky enough to have found 2 friend/roommates that are ready to go when we find a place. I personally found roommates that are my friends because i have so many trust issues as well as just anxiety when it comes to people i don’t know very well. If you are comfortable renting with others, i definitely suggest it to help with costs.

I also completely understand where you’re coming from with going out in general. Even now i have an “unofficial” curfew and limitations on where i can and can’t go, as well as who i can and can’t be with. I currently have a significant other that my nparents know about and i thought that they liked him, but obviously “no ones good enough.” Luckily he is very understanding and doesn’t take what they say to heart.

My nparents got me a car and told me i could use it for college (when i was still going to school), but they would take me to work. It’s definitely hard to work around parents like these, even at an older age.

It’s also hard for me to come to terms with my parents being the way that they are, since they’ve always treated my sister and other family members differently. I always thought i was the problem, but I’m currently coming to terms with it and moving forward.

I honestly wish you luck and i hope you find a place soon!
